title: Build identification and documentation refresh
changes: Show the running application build number in a footer visible on Mac and iPhone.
Link the build label to a portal release-notes page, with matching read-only build and release-history API endpoints.
Use one packaged release manifest for the displayed build, portal history and generated Markdown release notes; no Git checkout or Docker configuration change is needed at runtime.
Refresh the README, contributor instructions and project specification to describe deployed inventory, photo identification, metadata search, AI similarity reviews and remaining plans accurately.
Document release numbering, manual backup safeguards and the verified deployment history. Inventory data, photographs and provider settings are unchanged.

title: Selected-component AI reviews and aligned cards
changes: Select 2–8 components and explicitly review every selected pair with Claude, OpenAI or both independently. This workflow sends descriptive metadata, not photographs or inventory organization.
Compare verdicts, confidence, explanations and missing evidence; retain saved review snapshots and download self-contained HTML reports.

Apply checked pair classifications after human review: possible duplicate, related but distinct, different components, or return to automatic matching. Update reciprocal links and save warnings without merging records or changing stock.
Reject stale/deleted pairs atomically. Bind decisions to both UUIDs and identifying metadata; publish SSE after commit and preserve review history.
Align stock/status and Compare controls within each card row, including cards with long names and expanded related links.
Add isolated API/provider-failure and Chromium/WebKit workflow tests. The deployed feature passed 81 tests and CI.

title: Correct sensor similarity classification
changes: Distinguish different sensing functions rather than linking modules solely because they share an LM393 or another common support IC.
Preserve exact model and same-function matches. Apply the correction consistently to reciprocal portal links and similar-save checks.
Keep every inventory record and photograph; no automatic merges or quantity adjustments.

title: Inventory numbers, comparison, categories and search
changes: Assign permanent INV-000001-style inventory numbers using an additive ledger; retain UUIDs and never reuse numbers after deletion.
Show inventory numbers on cards, forms, comparisons, search and CSV exports. Compare two saved entries or an unsaved draft with a possible match.
Add advisory similar-save warnings, explicit separate-save confirmation, reciprocal related-item links and stable UUID hash links.
Normalize categories to readable Title Case with electronics acronyms preserved. Collapse case/spacing duplicates without merging distinct descriptive categories.
Search all textual/numeric metadata with partial terms, multi-field queries and bounded typo matching. Exclude uploaded image bytes and internal image paths.

title: Responsive mobile layout and stock default
changes: Keep dashboard, forms, comparison content and notifications within the available viewport, including mobile browser chrome and simulated keyboard/zoom changes.
Add safe-area spacing, readable inputs, touch controls and Chromium/WebKit layout regression checks.
Default the low-stock threshold to 1 for new records while preserving all existing thresholds and explicit zero values.

title: AI diagnostics and metadata validation
changes: Record bounded, private, rotating provider diagnostics on the Mac with request IDs, response text, status/timing and fallback reasons. Redact keys and image data.
Validate both providers against the descriptive metadata contract and inventory field lengths. Preserve complete overlong labels in notes when possible.
Prefill descriptive fields for review and show actionable field validation errors instead of a generic save failure. Retain unsaved fields and photo choices on retry.

title: Multi-photo identification with Claude primary
changes: Identify one component from 1–6 selected JPEG/PNG/WebP views, with 10 MiB per-image and 20 MiB total limits.
Use Claude first and OpenAI as backup on request failure or unusable output, with visible provider routing. Low confidence alone does not trigger fallback.
Store at most two catalog photos, front and back, using an additive image_back migration. Keep additional identification views temporary unless selected for catalog storage.
Prefill name, category, manufacturer, model and notes for user review. Add mocked multi-photo/provider and migration coverage.

title: API regression suite and CI
changes: Add automated coverage for inventory CRUD, filters, validation, statistics, photo uploads and retention, CSV, mocked AI, persistence and SSE.
Run isolated Python and JavaScript checks in GitHub Actions on pull requests and main, without secrets or deployment credentials.

title: Live inventory synchronization
changes: Publish SSE inventory invalidations after successful commits and on connection; reconnect automatically with a three-second hint.
Refresh on browser focus, visibility and network return. Serialize/coalesce reads, retry failures and preserve filters and unsaved forms.
Keep one Uvicorn worker for in-process event delivery and verify real HTTP/SSE streams using isolated storage.

title: Initial Inventory Portal and project context
changes: Create the FastAPI/SQLite inventory portal with vanilla JavaScript/CSS, Docker Compose and persistent local inventory/photo storage.
Provide component CRUD, quantity/location/project metadata, stock statistics, photo storage, CSV export and optional OpenAI photo identification.
Establish architecture, development priorities, preservation requirements and explicit deployment approval rules in project documentation (documentation merged separately at 52a0f30).
